maria (sec): Heads up — we saw a burst of sessions where the OIDC introspection endpoint returned HTTP 202 instead of 200 and RBAC audit entries are missing for those sessions. noticed in prod around 09:12 UTC. Anyone seen 202 from introspect before?
jonathan (infra): @maria (sec) not typical. 202 sounds like the idp-proxy is treating the token check as async. can you paste the raw response headers/body?
maria (sec): here's one anonymized sample from the proxy logs: `GET /introspect token=*** -> 202`
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-Id: r9a3-zz
Body: {"status":"pending","check_id":"chk_abc123"}
```
jonathan (infra): hmm. idp-proxy started returning 202 after the last deploy of proxy v1.14.2? ops-bot, did we have a deploy around 09:00 UTC?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: deployment completed for service=idp-proxy image=redwood/idp-proxy:v1.14.2 at 08:57:32 UTC :white_check_mark:
samir (platform): I pushed the async introspect feature to avoid blocking on remote idp for long-lived spikes. it returns 202 while it queues verification. but we intended the gateway to translate to 200 once verification completes — maybe the callback path failed.
lia (prod-sec): the RBAC sidecar only records audit entries when the introspection response is 200 with `active: true`. anything else is treated as unauthenticated and we drop audit logging. that's why there are gaps.
maria (sec): ok so the chain is: app -> gateway -> idp-proxy (202 while queued) -> gateway expected to poll or callback -> final 200. Looks like the finalization didn't complete for some requests.
jonathan (infra): quick mitigation: can we make the gateway accept 202 and add a transient audit record with `status: pending` so we don't lose traceability? then backfill final result when callback arrives. low-risk change.
samir (platform): yes, we can add that header mapping in the gateway config. patch suggestion:
```
# gateway mapping snippet
- match: status == 202
  set-header: X-Introspect-Status: pending
  log-audit: true
```
lia (prod-sec): that would at least give us an audit trail for decisions made while token was pending. long term we should change sidecar to log intermediate states and correlate by check_id.
maria (sec): action items: 1) samir to push gateway quick patch (accept 202 -> create pending audit) 2) team to investigate why idp-proxy never delivered final callback for ~2k requests 3) create alert if introspect returns 202 rate > 1% for 5m. who takes 1 and 2? :point_down:
samir (platform): I'll do the gateway patch now, will open PR and notify once live.
jonathan (infra): I'll dig into proxy callback failures and check SQS / callback worker logs. posting first traces in this thread soon.
lia (prod-sec): I'll add a temporary audit rule to include `X-Introspect-Status` and wire it into Splunk. also adding the 1% alert.
maria (sec): thanks all. please paste PR/links here. once patched we'll run a small canary and verify RBAC audit entries appear for pending -> resolved flows. :thumbsup:
